title: Testing Strategies
description: Write robust automated tests. Tests unit testing pure functions, mocking databases for integration tests, and orchestrating E2E test flows.

seo.overviewBody: Automated testing ensures software code is reliable and regression-free. Engineering managers test candidates on applying the Testing Pyramid (Unit, Integration, E2E), mocking external dependencies (Jest/Vitest mocks, MSW), and targeting meaningful code coverage metrics.

deliverables.title: 1. Testing Strategy & Coverage Target Spec
deliverables.desc: Testing document establishing unit vs integration test boundaries, mocking guidelines, and coverage targets.

deliverables.title: 2. Unit & Integration Test Suite (Jest / Vitest / MSW)
deliverables.desc: Comprehensive test suite covering domain logic, API handlers, and database interactions.

deliverables.title: 3. Automated Code Coverage & Benchmark Report
deliverables.desc: Coverage report verifying 80%+ branch/line coverage with deterministic test execution times.

faqs.question: What is the Testing Pyramid?
faqs.answer: The Testing Pyramid recommends a foundation of many fast, cheap Unit Tests, a moderate layer of Integration Tests, and a thin top layer of slower E2E Tests.

faqs.question: Why is Mock Service Worker (MSW) preferred for API mocking?
faqs.answer: MSW intercepts network requests at the network layer using Service Workers, allowing tests to use real fetch calls without modifying application code.

faqs.question: Why can 100% code coverage be a misleading vanity metric?
faqs.answer: 100% line coverage only proves code executed during tests, not that assertions verified correctness or edge-case handling.
